scenarios.name: ParallelSP1-01 max_workers=1 produces identical output artifacts

steps.text: an LLM that returns valid responses for all stages
the full SP1 run is executed with max_workers 1
a file loss-analysis.yaml exists in the run directory
a file capability-profile.yaml exists in the run directory
a file control-structure.yaml exists in the run directory

scenarios.name: ParallelSP1-02 stage execution order preserved with max_workers=1

steps.text: an LLM that returns valid responses for all stages
the full SP1 run is executed with max_workers 1
Stage 1a loss analysis is produced first
Stage 1b capability profile is produced second
Stage 2 control structure is produced third

scenarios.name: ParallelSP1-03 call log identical with max_workers=1

steps.text: an LLM that returns valid responses for all stages
a run directory for output
the full SP1 run is executed with max_workers 1
a file calls.jsonl exists in the run directory
the file contains entries for stage_1a, stage_1b, and stage_2 in order

scenarios.name: ParallelSP1-04 SP1 does not call parallel_safe_llm_calls when max_workers=1

steps.text: an LLM that returns valid responses for all stages
the full SP1 run is executed with max_workers 1
all LLM calls go through safe_llm_call directly
no parallel_safe_llm_calls invocation occurs

scenarios.name: ParallelSP1-05 SP1 data dependencies prevent parallelization

steps.text: the SP1 pipeline stage dependencies
Stage 1b depends on the output of Stage 1a
Stage 2 Call 1 depends on the output of Stage 1b
Stage 2 Call 2 depends on the output of Stage 2 Call 1
Stage 2 Call 3 depends on the output of Stage 2 Call 2
the critic depends on the output of Stage 2 Call 3
the revision depends on the output of the critic

scenarios.name: ParallelSP1-06 existing SP1 tests pass with parallel module present

steps.text: the parallel_llm module is installed in stpa/infra
the existing SP1 test suite is run
no new failures are introduced

background.text: the STPA system model run module is importable
